scope:
Audit saved slide experiments, replay selected projections, retain compact evidence.

No query hook, emulator/ROM equivalence or controller-reachability theorem is
claimed. Output includes every supplied recipe, all outcomes, and full traces for
selected positive and negative cases. Raw files are hashed and retained locally.

sourceAndRuntime.scope:
Finite JP supplied-slide handoff diagnostics. No claim of controller reachability.

Uses the existing authenticated four-pillar prefix and unedited native surfaces,
cache, warp, top behavior, RNG and allocator. Every gameplay setup edit is logged.
After the last setup edit only controller pads are written until trial end.
sourceAndRuntime.observationLimit: Native completed frame fields and Wafel action/movement event log; no direct query or quarter-return hook.

entry.scope: Controller-only suffix after prior supplied exterior freefall; no pusher supplied; finite policies, not a complete route or exclusion.

entryCuts.scope:
Supplied high walking/freefall entry cuts followed by native no-A transitions.

No initialized slide action, slide velocity, floor/cache, platform, or later actor
position is supplied. These are still conditional setup cuts, not clean routes.
